raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be a coworking space"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Brasov"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have parking"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "be near"
  role subject ?x
  role object "Livada Postei"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
